- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Home notifications showed no effect across two tests.
Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Interactions Practice Screen: Add an interactive practice screen after home intro where users practice dragging and summoning their pet on desktop. (why: Support receives multiple tickets asking how to control, hide, or talk to the pet, and 19% of users drop off at finish.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Spotlight Story Narrative Redesign: Redesign the story introduction screen using a spotlight layout to prominently showcase the core desktop pet experience. (why: The choose_path step experiences a 20.6% drop-off; a spotlight layout highlights the pet companion value proposition immediately.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Accessory Selection Flow: Insert an accessory selection screen before photo upload so users choose a starter collar or bow for their pet. (why: Adoption has a mean duration of 1017s; adding immediate cosmetic customization deepens engagement during setup.)
3: [adoption, redesign] Carousel Layout Pick Friend Redesign: Redesign the pick friend screen to a carousel layout with live companion previews. (why: Adoption step takes a median of 89s with 18.1% drop-off; a carousel presentation simplifies companion browsing.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Startup Sound Tips on Waiting Screen: Display explicit desktop taskbar location hints on the waiting screen while background setup completes. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop; setting expectations during loading prevents confusion.)
5: [finish, copy] Home Introduction Control Key Headline Update: Update the headline and body copy on home intro to explicitly mention primary shortcut keys for pet controls. (why: Post-onboarding support tickets show users are confused about how to hide or summon their pet after completing setup.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Setup Duration Hint: Add a informative hint text on the path selection screen emphasizing that setup takes under one minute. (why: Choose path mean duration is 514s with 20.6% drop-off; setting quick setup expectations reduces friction.)
7: [home, new_screen] Pet Voice Sound Diagnostic Screen: Add a pet sound test step before waiting screen to ensure system audio and desktop notifications work. (why: Users take a median 201s / mean 2336s on waiting/home step; a quick audio check confirms desktop launch readiness.)
